question: Top 3 de sponsors de la industria por cantidad de ensayos detenidos (terminados o retirados) en cáncer de pulmón, considerando solo el sponsor principal.

attempts.query:
SELECT sp.name
FROM aact.sponsors sp
JOIN aact.studies s ON s.nct_id = sp.nct_id
WHERE sp.lead_or_collaborator = 'lead' AND sp.agency_class = 'INDUSTRY'
  AND s.overall_status IN ('TERMINATED','WITHDRAWN')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM linking.trial_condition tc
              JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
              JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id
              WHERE tc.nct_id = s.nct_id AND md.label = 'Lung Neoplasms')
GROUP BY sp.name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.nct_id) DESC
LIMIT 3
